question_text: A cleaning solution is made by mixing bleach and water in a ratio of 1:9. If you need 5 liters of bleach, how many liters of water should you add?

hint_ladder.title: Orient
hint_ladder.text: This is a ratio problem. The ratio 1:9 tells you the relationship between bleach and water. Think of it like a recipe: 1 cup bleach needs 9 cups wa...

hint_ladder.title: Rule
hint_ladder.text: In a part-to-part ratio like this, the second number tells how many parts of water per part bleach. So water is always 9 times the bleach.

hint_ladder.title: Apply
hint_ladder.text: You have 5 liters bleach. Water is 9 times that: 5 x 9. That gives exact water liters.

hint_ladder.title: Nearly There
hint_ladder.text: 5 x 9 = 45. So 45 liters water, option C. Careful: only add bleach if total solution is asked.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you used 7 as multiplier. The ratio 1:9 means multiply by 9, not 7.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you mistakenly multiplied by 8. Ang tamang multiplier ay 9, nasa ratio mismo.

C.text: Correct. Multiply 5 liters bleach by 9 to get 45 liters water.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you added bleach to water total. Pero water lang ang hinihingi, huwag i-add.

next_time_rule: Ratio 1:9? Multiply given by 9—'wag i-total unless total ang tanong.
blueprint_id: Mixture Ratios — Bleach and Water Solution
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo tulong ka kay Kapitan sa barangay, naghahalo ng disinfectant. Ang ratio ng bleach sa tubig ay 1:9. May 5 litrong bleach ka, kaya't kailangan mo ng 9 na bahagi ng tubig. I-multiply lang: 5 x 9 = 45 litrong tubig.

**Watch-Out Zone: ratio_total_part_confusion** in action. Water lang, huwag i-add ang b...

Mental trick: Tandaan mo, 'Multiply by second number, 'wag i-total.' Kaya C (45) ang sagot, hindi A, B, o D. Madalas magkamali sa pag-add, pero part lang talaga ang kailangan.
